title: Delhi Weather Alert: Western Disturbance to Bring Rain, Thunderstorms & Cooler Temperatures Till March 30
text:
New Delhi, India — March 26, 2026
A fresh spell of pleasant weather is set to continue in the national capital as a Western Disturbance remains active over North India. The India Meteorological Department has issued a multi-day weather alert, forecasting rain, thunderstorms, and strong winds across Delhi this week.
According to the IMD, March 26, 27, 29, and 30 are likely to witness rainfall accompanied by lightning and gusty winds, bringing relief from rising temperatures.
Rain & Wind Alert This Week
The weather department has predicted wind speeds of 30 to 40 km/h on most of these days, except March 28. Scattered rainfall across different parts of Delhi is expected to keep conditions relatively cool and comfortable.
Officials added that fluctuating weather patterns will continue through the week, with mostly cloudy and wet conditions preventing any sharp rise in temperature.
Temperature & Humidity Update
On Wednesday, Delhi experienced strong sunshine during the day, leading to a brief spike in heat levels. However, cool winds helped maintain overall comfort.
- Maximum Temperature: 33.5°C
- Minimum Temperature: 16.4°C
- Maximum Humidity: 94%
- Minimum Humidity: 33%
Area-Wise Temperature Readings
Different parts of Delhi recorded varying maximum temperatures:
- Ridge: 34°C
- Ayanagar: 33.7°C
- Lodhi Road: 33.8°C
- Palam: 31.9°C
Why Is Delhi’s Weather Changing?
Meteorologists attribute the changing weather pattern to an active Western Disturbance, a system that originates in the Mediterranean region and brings rain and snowfall to northern parts of India.
Recent snowfall in the Himalayan region has further contributed to the shift, resulting in cooler winds and intermittent rainfall across Delhi.
Weather Outlook
Delhi is expected to witness rain, thunderstorms, and winds up to 40 km/h between March 26 and March 30 due to an active Western Disturbance, leading to a drop in temperatures.
FAQ Section
Q1. Why is Delhi experiencing cooler weather in March 2026?
Delhi’s weather is influenced by an active Western Disturbance, bringing rain, clouds, and cooler winds.
Q2. When will it rain in Delhi this week?
Rain is expected on March 26, 27, 29, and 30, with thunderstorms and gusty winds.
Q3. What will be the wind speed during this period?
Wind speeds are likely to range between 30 to 40 km/h.
Q4. Will temperatures rise in Delhi soon?
No major temperature spike is expected due to continuous cloud cover and rainfall.
